summary: The recorded base reproduces the missing Sana AutoencoderDC tiling API. At the exact candidate commit, the wrapper forwards the no-argument DecodingStage request to a real diffusers AutoencoderDC, enables tiling, and completes an independently forced tiled CPU/GPU decode. No source-level counterexample to the original explicit --vae-tiling contract remains. Full Sana/8 GB CUDA OOM validation was unavailable and is not claimed.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual checkout wrapper at the recorded base raises AttributeError because enable_tiling is absent; see raw/base-failure.txt.
Candidate regression and nearby decoding suite: 12 passed; see raw/candidate-focused-suite.txt.

Independent real diffusers wrapper test verified default tiling state/thresholds, forced tiled decode, one visible gfx950 GPU, output shape [1,3,16,16], and GPU-vs-CPU max absolute error 4.172325134277344e-07; see raw/independent-gpu-tiled-decode.txt.

gpu_execution_evidence: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. A real tiny diffusers AutoencoderDC tiled decode ran through the candidate wrapper and matched CPU within 4.172325134277344e-07.
remaining_limitations: Efficient-Large-Model/Sana_600M_512px_diffusers weights were unavailable, so no full Sana generation or semantic image-quality claim is made.
The assigned ROCm 7.2 gfx950 MI350X is not the reported 8 GB RTX 4070 Laptop CUDA GPU; the fatal CUDA OOM and memory reduction were not directly reproduced or quantified.
SanaPipelineConfig.vae_tiling remains false by default; the candidate resolves the explicit --vae-tiling request, not the issue's separate default-policy question.
Diffusers 0.37.0 raises TypeError during decode for fractional explicit tile stride values despite float annotations; the original no-argument DecodingStage path is unaffected.
No native code changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
